This review of her newest is typed by a playgoer who admires her experimentation, finds her initial ideas interesting, but is consistently disappointed and disinterested while sitting through her lengthy productions.
A brilliant new play by superstar playwright Annie Baker.
For the constantly surprising John — which, not incidentally, goes by as if in minutes, when many 90-minute works seem to last eons
It is a complex work that gets under your skin and then sneaks into your soul.

John is not for everyone – if you like your plays plotty and energetic, go no further. John doesn't really say much or travel very far. But its glimpses of humanity in its natural habitat more than compensate for its sometimes static feel.
